originalityFinding: Three near-full flags arose from the same guide sentence repeated at sources 2694, 4531 and 4677.

before.en: You can reserve a place with a few taps; the app asks only for a time slot and confirmation.
before.zh: 你在程式上點幾下就能留位；它只要你選時間並確認。

after.en: Booking a place takes just a few taps in the app: choose a time slot, then confirm.
after.zh: 在程式中預約名額只需點幾下：選時段，再按確認。
